messages.subject: checking in
parts:
Hi everyone,

I haven't had much time to give to (Py)Stan in the last few weeks as I'm
teaching this term. I trust you folks will let me know if there's an
upcoming release or a weekly call at which my presence would be useful
(PyStan, Stan 3.0, ...).

Thanks,

Allen

p.s. If I find some extra time, I'll probably spend it trying to get a
common C++ ess/rhat calculation for PyStan (and RStan).
